use_cases: Form submission triggers with multiple visual variants
Navigation action buttons with customizable sizes
Icon-only buttons for compact UI interfaces
Accessible button composition using Radix Slot
Themeable button system for design systems
ai_summary: A reusable atomic button component with multiple variants (default, destructive, outline, secondary, ghost, link) and sizes (default, sm, lg, icon). Built with Radix UI Slot for composition flexibility and class-variance-authority for type-safe variant management. Standard flat styling with Tailwind CSS, optimized for accessibility with focus ring support.
